name: Analytical multifidelity optimization benchmark suite
description: A collection of analytical benchmark problems and a methodological framework for assessing and comparing multifidelity optimization methods.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on algorithmic performance; evaluation typically reports best-found objective, convergence curves and cost vs fidelity. Small/analytical problem suite with varying fidelities — not a large-scale dataset. Risk of implementation-specific tuning impacting comparability.
